near_dup.algorithm: dhash-64: grayscale L, LANCZOS resize 9x8, right>left, row-major, MSB first

union_confirm.rule: dhash <= union_max_hamming AND phash256 <= phash256_max AND min(grey entropy) >= min_entropy_bits
union_confirm.entropy: shannon entropy of the 8-bit grayscale (L) histogram of the whole image
union_confirm.rejected: links nothing; a new/prior-release pair joins the prior-release band

ood.tropical_province: D-P holdout: none qualifies (no province in the tropical realms ['Central Indo-Pacific', 'Eastern Indo-Pacific', 'Tropical Eastern Pacific', 'Western Indo-Pacific'] (excl. Tropical Atlantic) has >= 500 labelled images)

pins.rule: route-to-our-test manifests: eval split -> test, second held-out split -> validation; never-eval-only train and OOD claims win over a pin; a pin wins over an inherited v1.0 split (recorded in v1_continuity_overridden) and over a band evaluation split it does not accept; a pinned component the v1.0 band forces to train (never-eval) is withheld; test beats validation
